⚡ 8 Transformation Priorities

1. Woodland Creation Grant Automation

End-to-end digital EWCO from submission to payment. Target: 80% processing reduction from 16 to 3 weeks. Automated land eligibility against agricultural classification. Species selection AI using soil, climate, biodiversity data. Satellite-verified planting milestones triggering payment. ELMS integration for combined payments. Digital mapping for landowner boundary delineation.

2. Tree Health AI Surveillance Network

National pest and disease early warning using satellite and field data. Target: 90% outbreak detection within 14 days. Automated risk from import trade pathways. Forest Research lab sample prioritisation. Public reporting app with photo AI. Biosecurity monitoring at ports and yards. Outbreak containment auto-designation.

3. Carbon Sequestration Digital MRV

End-to-end digital MRV for Woodland Carbon Code. Target: 95% automated verification, 70% cost reduction. Satellite biomass estimation for carbon stock change. Automated milestone verification for credit issuance. Permanence monitoring with fire, disease, storm alerts. Carbon registry blockchain for provenance. UK ETS data feed integration.

4. Felling Licence Digital Workflow

Paperless application, assessment, and decision pipeline. Target: 70% decided within 8 weeks. Automated exempt classification reducing unnecessary applications. Restocking condition satellite monitoring. GIS with coupe boundaries. Automated NE SSSI consultation. Digital appeals with evidence upload.

5. Ancient Woodland Protection AI

Automated planning consultation near ancient woodland. Target: 95% responded within 21 days. AWI integration with local authority portals. Impact modelling from development proposals. Buffer zone enforcement via change detection. PAWS restoration tracking with condition scoring. Veteran tree risk assessment and priority AI.

6. Timber Chain of Custody Blockchain

Blockchain-verified timber origin from forest to site. Target: 100% UK-grown timber traceable to source. UKTR due diligence automation for imports. FSC/PEFC certification at point of sale. Illegal logging risk scoring. Sawmill data for volume reconciliation. Construction compliance for structural timber.

7. Wildfire Risk Prediction Platform

Real-time prediction with Met Office, satellite, terrain data. Target: 48-hour advance warning for high-risk events. Fuel load modelling from NFI biomass and history. Automated controlled burn scheduling. Community risk notification for adjacent properties. Post-fire severity via Sentinel-2. Fire and rescue mobilisation integration.

8. Parliamentary Evidence Pipeline

Automated evidence for Ministerial, Select Committee, NAO. Target: 90% WPQs responded within 5 working days. Real-time planting dashboard for Ministerial briefings. Cross-devolved forestry comparison analytics. International commitment progress reporting. Forestry statistics Code of Practice. Spending review evidence from operational data.

🚫 Red Lines (Never Crossed)

  • ❌ No ancient woodland or veteran tree removed without Natural England consultation and statutory assessment — every site must receive full ecological survey and irreplaceable habitat determination
  • ❌ No felling licence approved without restocking condition and biodiversity impact assessment — every licence must include species, area, and timeframe for restocking compliance
  • ❌ No carbon credit issued without independent third-party verification against Woodland Carbon Code — no self-assessed sequestration claims accepted for registry entry
  • ❌ No tree health emergency action without Forest Research evidence and Forestry Minister notification — no pre-emptive felling without confirmed pathogen identification
  • ❌ No automated felling licence refusal without human review and applicant right of appeal — every refusal requires FC caseworker sign-off and appeal notification
  • ❌ No woodland grant payment released without satellite-verified planting evidence within 12 months — no advance payments without geotagged photographic confirmation

🤝 5-Step Engagement Model

1
Discovery: Map FC landscape (~1.3M ha estate). Assess grant volumes and tree health coverage. Benchmark felling licence turnaround. Profile carbon MRV pipeline. Identify ancient woodland bottlenecks. Map cross-agency flows (NE, Forest Research, EA).
2
Governance Design: Deploy DEFONEOS MCP servers for FC use cases. Configure grant automation, tree health surveillance, carbon MRV. Establish ancient woodland protection AI. Design timber chain of custody with industry.
3
Pilot: 90-day pilot across 3 Forestry England districts and 2 Forest Research stations. Measure grant accuracy, tree health detection, carbon verification. Collect landowner, ranger, scientist, caseworker feedback.
4
Scale: Roll out across all FC operations nationally. Integrate NFI, satellite, Met Office fire feeds. Deploy across devolved forestry partners. Timber blockchain rollout to UK sawmills.
5
Assure: Continuous audit-grade governance reporting. Tree health dashboards. Parliamentary evidence. Carbon verification metrics. Ancient woodland compliance. Grant payment integrity.
